verdict.rationale: Refunds are a core axis for a point-of-sale product, but the evidence pack never mentions issuing refunds, full or partial, to the original card from POS, the admin dashboard, or the API. The only related item covers exchanges for online or other-location purchases, which is not a refund to the original payment method. The generic note that extensions can query the GraphQL Admin API does not show any refund capability.
